diffs.patch:
Index: pom.xml
===================================================================
--- pom.xml	
+++ pom.xml	
@@ -0,0 +1,62 @@
+<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
+<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
+         xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
+         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
+    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>
+
+    <groupId>com.example</groupId>
+    <artifactId>demo-app</artifactId>
+    <version>1.0.0-SNAPSHOT</version>
+    <packaging>jar</packaging>
+
+    <name>demo-app</name>
+    <description>Maven project using Lombok to reduce boilerplate code</description>
+
+    <properties>
+        <project.build.sourceEncoding>UTF-8</project.build.sourceEncoding>
+        <maven.compiler.release>21</maven.compiler.release>
+        <lombok.version>1.18.48</lombok.version>
+        <junit.version>5.11.4</junit.version>
+    </properties>
+
+    <dependencies>
+        <dependency>
+            <groupId>org.projectlombok</groupId>
+            <artifactId>lombok</artifactId>
+            <version>${lombok.version}</version>
+            <scope>provided</scope>
+        </dependency>
+
+        <dependency>
+            <groupId>org.junit.jupiter</groupId>
+            <artifactId>junit-jupiter</artifactId>
+            <version>${junit.version}</version>
+            <scope>test</scope>
+        </dependency>
+    </dependencies>
+
+    <build>
+        <plugins>
+            <plugin>
+                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
+                <artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId>
+                <version>3.13.0</version>
+                <configuration>
+                    <annotationProcessorPaths>
+                        <path>
+                            <groupId>org.projectlombok</groupId>
+                            <artifactId>lombok</artifactId>
+                            <version>${lombok.version}</version>
+                        </path>
+                    </annotationProcessorPaths>
+                </configuration>
+            </plugin>
+
+            <plugin>
+                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
+                <artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId>
+                <version>3.5.2</version>
+            </plugin>
+        </plugins>
+    </build>
+</project>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
         xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>

    <groupId>com.example</groupId>
    <artifactId>demo-app</artifactId>
    <version>1.0.0-SNAPSHOT</version>
    <packaging>jar</packaging>

    <name>demo-app</name>
    <description>Maven project using Lombok to reduce boilerplate code</description>

    <properties>
        <project.build.sourceEncoding>UTF-8</project.build.sourceEncoding>
        <maven.compiler.release>21</maven.compiler.release>
        <lombok.version>1.18.48</lombok.version>
        <junit.version>5.11.4</junit.version>

            <artifactId>lombok</artifactId>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.junit.jupiter</groupId>
            <artifactId>junit-jupiter</artifactId>
            <version>${junit.version}</version>
            <scope>test</scope>

    <build>
        <plugins>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.13.0</version>
                <configuration>
                    <annotationProcessorPaths>
                        <path>
                            <groupId>org.projectlombok</groupId>
                            <artifactId>lombok</artifactId>
                            <version>${lombok.version}</version>
                        </path>
                    </annotationProcessorPaths>
                </configuration>

                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.5.2</version>
            </plugin>
        </plugins>
    </build>
</project>

parts.text:
Done. Created a Maven project wired with **Lombok** to eliminate boilerplate. Tests pass (7/7) and the app runs.

Structure:
- `pom.xml` — Lombok 1.18.48 (`provided`) + annotation processor path, JUnit 5, Java 21 target
- `src/main/java/com/example/demo/model/User.java` — `@Data @Builder @NoArgsConstructor @AllArgsConstructor` replaces all getters/setters/equals/hashCode/toString/constructors
- `src/main/java/com/example/demo/service/UserService.java` — `@RequiredArgsConstructor` for constructor injection
- `src/main/java/com/example/demo/Application.java` — `@Log` for the logger
- `src/test/...` — JUnit tests verifying the generated methods
- `.gitignore`, `target/`

Build/run:
```
mvn clean verify
mvn exec:java -Dexec.mainClass=com.example.demo.Application   # or java -cp ...
```

Note: JDK 26 emits an `Unsafe` deprecation warning from Lombok; harmless, but if the team uses JDK 26+ natively (rather than targeting 21) they may want to watch for a newer Lombok release.
